Prevention: Pseudomonas 10 gm per kg of seed.
Avoid water stagnation and provide good drainage.
Effective weed control and field sanitation.
Wash and sterilise farming tools after use and before moving to another field location.
Monitoring: During the wet season, observe for purple fungal growth on the lower surface of leaves.
Common symptoms include greasy and crispy appearance of leaves, yellow-brown angular spots and purple-grey downy growths.
July- September for downy growth at upper surface of leaves.
Consider direct control actions as soon as symptoms are observed.
Direct Control: Bacillus subtilis (400 ml) per acre on foliage.
Restrictions: The fungicides mentioned in this guide are strictly to be applied before flowering and fruiting.
